{{Quote|Look at this thing. It looks like it's been in every battle since the Clone Wars&mdash;|[[Zuckuss/Legends|Zuckuss]], admiring [[D'harhan]]'s ship, just prior to the latter reacting to the intrusion|<ref name="The Mandalorian Armor">''[[The Mandalorian Armor]]''</ref>}}
This '''featureless ovoid craft''' was used by the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[D'harhan]]. No bigger than a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighter]], it looked similar to an [[Egg/Legends|egg]] and trailed a metallic seine behind it. When the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] would land, a portion of the seine would curl over the back of the ship like a [[Scorpion/Legends|scorpion's]] tail. There was no visible hatch and the ship was covered in scorch marks, which gave it the appearance of having been through every battle since the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] arranged clearance for this ship to land at the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]].
